constructor.details: Starting at 1 ensures proposal 0 never exists; its default ENDED status is used      as a precondition gate in create().

create(address,string,string).details: Only callable by the owner (Orchestrator). Requires the previous proposal (proposalCounter - 1)      to be in ENDED status, enforcing a single active proposal at a time. Proposal 0 is never      created, so its default ENDED status allows the first proposal to be submitted freely.

params.sender: The address of the citizen creating the proposal (passed by the Orchestrator).

returns._0: The ID of the newly created proposal.

get(uint256).details: The votes map is excluded from the return value (not directly readable as a mapping).      Use getVoters + getVote to access individual vote data.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to read.

returns._2: creator The address of the proposal creator.
returns._3: creationTime The block timestamp at creation.
returns._4: votingTime The block timestamp when voting starts.
returns._6: endBlockHash The block hash recorded at closure (bytes32(0) if not yet closed).
returns.status: The current status (ENDED, CREATED, or ONGOING).

returns._0: The current Types.Status (ENDED, CREATED, or ONGOING).

getVote(uint256,address).details: Only callable by the owner (Orchestrator). Proposal must be in ENDED status.      The returned uint256 maps to Types.Vote (0 = NULL, 1 = NO, 2 = YES).

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal (must be ENDED).
params.voter: The address of the voter to query.

returns._0: The uint256 encoding of the voter's Types.Vote choice.

getVoters(uint256).details: Only callable by the owner (Orchestrator). Used by countVotes() to iterate over voters.

params.voter: The address of the citizen to check.

returns._0: True if the citizen has cast a vote on this proposal.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

startVoting(uint256).details: Only callable by the owner (Orchestrator). Reverts if the PREPARATION_PERIOD has not      elapsed since creation. Transitions the proposal to ONGOING status.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to open for voting.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

vote(uint256,address,uint8).details: Only callable by the owner (Orchestrator). If the VOTING_PERIOD has elapsed since      startVoting, the proposal is automatically closed via close() and the function returns false.      Otherwise, validates the vote and records it. A voter can only vote once per proposal.      NULL votes are rejected. The vote value must be within the bounds of the Vote enum.

params._vote: The vote choice. Must be YES or NO.
params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to vote on.
params.sender: The address of the voting citizen (passed by the Orchestrator).

returns._0: True if the vote was successfully recorded; false if the voting period had expired.

PREPARATION_PERIOD().notice: Minimum delay between proposal creation and the opening of the voting window.

VOTING_PERIOD().notice: Duration of the voting window after startVoting is called.

constructor.notice: Initializes the contract and sets the proposal counter to 1.

get(uint256).notice: Returns the public metadata of a proposal.

getStatus(uint256).notice: Returns the current status of a proposal.

getVote(uint256,address).notice: Returns the raw vote value cast by a specific voter on a closed proposal.

getVoters(uint256).notice: Returns the list of all addresses that cast a vote on a given proposal.

hasVoted(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether a given citizen has already voted on a proposal.

proposalCounter().notice: Monotonically increasing counter used to assign proposal IDs.

startVoting(uint256).notice: Opens the voting window for a proposal in CREATED status.

vote(uint256,address,uint8).notice: Records a citizen's vote on an ongoing proposal.
